title: Late Reactivation Fee Tariff for Grace-Period Renewals of Domain Registrations
content:
## Late reactivation fee — tariff note

For a grace-period renewal of Domain Registrations billed on or after 1 December 2025, the late reactivation fee is part of the amount of the renewal and is set as follows.

1. The late reactivation fee is waived, nothing being charged, where the domain's most recent grace-period renewal charge carries a price-match refund, that is a refund line returning part but not all of that charge.
2. Where no such price-match refund stands and the renewal is made within 7 calendar days after the expiry date, the fee is the flat USD 2.50.
3. Where no such price-match refund stands and the renewal is made later, the fee is USD 0.50 for each calendar day from the day after the expiry date through the day of the renewal, capped at USD 12.00.

The late reactivation fee of a grace-period renewal is fixed only after the domain's most recent grace-period renewal charge, where it was billed from 1 January 2022 through 30 November 2025 by card or PayPal and earns Domain Care credits, carries its price-match refund.

### What counts as a price-match refund

A refund line against the domain's most recent grace-period renewal charge (the one with the latest charge date) that returns part of that charge but not all of it. A refund line returning the whole charge is not a price-match refund, and a refund against an older grace-period renewal charge does not count.

### Counting the days

Day 1 is the day after the expiry date recorded on the domain; the day of the renewal is counted too.

| Days from the day after expiry through the renewal day | Fee where no price-match refund stands |
|---|---|
| 1 to 7 | USD 2.50 flat |
| 8 | USD 4.00 (USD 0.50 for each of 8 days) |
| 24 | USD 12.00 (the cap is reached) |
| 25 or more | USD 12.00 |

### Hypothetical cases

- Expiry date 10 March 2028, renewal on 17 March 2028: day 7, so USD 2.50.
- Same expiry, renewal on 18 March 2028: day 8, so USD 4.00.
- Same expiry, renewal on 6 April 2028: day 27, so the cap of USD 12.00.
- A domain whose most recent grace-period renewal charge carries a refund line returning part of it: nothing is charged, whatever the day.
